name: api-ingest
title: Chaos: metrics writer and Collector killed under constant OTLP load
summary: Constant OTLP/HTTP span load (20 spans/s, 5 per request) against the gateway's OTLP front door of the local single-node stack (project scf-wsl); the metrics writer and then the Collector killed with SIGKILL for 20 s each and started again. Status codes are judged per second of the load timeline; completeness by comparing the API's request counts with the spans answered 200.

checks.name: kill the metrics writer: the front door keeps answering 200 (Collector queue buffers)
kill the Collector: the front door refuses with 503 (never acknowledges unpersisted data), 200 again after restart
checks.detail: during the outage {"200":2,"503":78}; from 15 s after restart {"200":84}

checks.name: every span answered 200 is counted exactly once in the API (queue on disk survived, retries de-duplicated)
writer failover to a second core (C-77)
checks.detail: requires: two writers behind writers.mesh.local (the local stack has one)
